name: Smotts' Cutlass
summary: Smotts' Cutlass is Captain Smotts' blade, lost when Negolash took it from him. The captain wants it back in Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: A Captain's Blade
sections.body: Captain Smotts asks you to bring wine and Barbecued Buzzard Wings to his old lifeboat on the coast. Negolash, the hungry giant who destroyed the captain's ship, is fond of both. Smotts means to draw the giant close and reclaim his cutlass. The blade is in Negolash's hands.

faq.answer: Captain Smotts owns the cutlass and asks for its return.

faq.q: How did Negolash get the cutlass?
faq.answer: Negolash took the cutlass after the giant destroyed Captain Smotts' ship.

faq.q: Why does Smotts want wine and buzzard wings?
faq.answer: Negolash craves wine and Captain Smotts' Barbecued Buzzard Wings, so Smotts uses them to lure the giant to his old lifeboat.
Negolash has Smotts' Cutlass in Stranglethorn Vale.
